name: Comment Suite – Anti-Spam, Moderation, Cleanup & Voting
author: WPCodeForge

sections.description:
WPCodeForge Comment Suite brings common WordPress comment-management tools together in one central administration area.

The free edition provides local tools for controlling comments, reducing automated spam, moderating selected comments, cleaning unwanted comments and optionally adding comment voting.

No external anti-spam service is required for the core features.

Features

  • Disable comments globally or by public post type.
  • Require visitors to log in before commenting.
  • Automatically close comments after a configurable number of days.
  • Disable comment feeds.
  • Disable pingbacks and outgoing pingbacks.
  • Optionally remove REST API comment endpoints.
  • Optionally disable XML-RPC comment submissions.
  • Honeypot anti-bot protection.
  • Minimum submission time protection.
  • Maximum URL limits.
  • Minimum and maximum comment length.
  • Blocked words and phrases.
  • Blocked email domains.
  • Duplicate comment detection.
  • Hold comments containing links for moderation.
  • Hold first-time commenters for moderation.
  • Scheduled spam cleanup.
  • Remove the Website field.
  • Render comment links as non-clickable output.
  • Optional upvote and downvote controls.
  • Optional anonymous voting.
  • Comment cleanup filters.
  • Settings export.
  • Settings reset.
  • Centralised administration interface.

Get Pro

Comment Suite Pro is available for websites that need additional moderation, automation, reporting and management capabilities.

Learn more:

https://wpcodeforge.com/comment-suite-pro/

The free plugin remains fully functional without purchasing or activating the Pro edition.

Privacy

The core functionality of WPCodeForge Comment Suite operates locally within WordPress.

The free plugin does not transmit comment content to WPCodeForge as part of its standard comment-management functionality.

When anonymous voting is enabled, a randomly generated browser cookie is used to help prevent repeated votes. The associated random identifier may be stored with the relevant comment as voting metadata.

Administrators are responsible for configuring the plugin consistently with their own privacy and legal requirements.

Support

Website: https://wpcodeforge.com/

Comment Suite Pro: https://wpcodeforge.com/comment-suite-pro/

License

Credits

Creator, Founder and Developer: James William Steven Parker.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin.
  2. Install and activate WPCodeForge Comment Suite.
  3. Open Comment Suite in the WordPress administration menu.
  4. Review Protection, Engagement and Settings.
  5. Save the configuration appropriate for your website.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require a third-party spam service?

No. The included anti-spam protections operate locally.

Does disabling comments delete existing comments?

No. Existing comments remain until deliberately removed through WordPress or the Cleanup tools.

Can comments be closed automatically after a period of time?

Yes. Configure Automatically close comments under Comment Protection. Set the value to 0 to disable this rule.

Can I require users to log in before commenting?

Yes. Enable Require logged-in visitors.

Can I automatically moderate first-time commenters?

Yes. Enable Hold first-time commenters.

Can I automatically delete spam?

Yes. Enable Automatically delete spam. A daily scheduled task deletes up to 500 spam comments per run.

Can I export my settings?

Yes. The Settings screen includes an Export settings tool that downloads the current configuration as JSON.

Where is the Pro version?

Use the Get Pro section inside Comment Suite or visit https://wpcodeforge.com/comment-suite-pro/.
